ecosystem_case_count.formula: count(distinct rows in section '五个公开案例：只迁移机制，不移植结论')
assumptions: Submission-content inventory only; not a claim about the total global ecosystem population.

scenario_card_count.formula: count(distinct SC-01...SC-12 rows in section '十二张场景卡')
assumptions: Concept-card inventory; no card is an approved or deployed service.

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count(scenario cards whose class is INDUSTRY-TEST)
assumptions: Concept-card inventory; approval, operator, site, capacity, and safety evidence remain unknown.

persona_count.formula: count(distinct P-01...P-08 rows in section '八类任务画像')
assumptions: Task-persona inventory, not a survey result or a count of real people.

landmark_count.formula: count(distinct LM-01...LM-03 rows in section '三个朝圣地标概念')
assumptions: Concept inventory; location, heritage, ownership, engineering, and approval are unconfirmed.

public_space_component_type_count.formula: count(distinct C-01...C-08 rows in section '公共空间组件库')
assumptions: Reusable concept-type inventory, not a constructed-asset count.

spatial_story_stage_count.formula: count(distinct 01...05 rows in section '五幕空间故事线')
assumptions: Submission-content inventory; heritage interpretation and physical placement still require review.

signage_information_level_count.formula: count(distinct LINE, NODE, STORY, STATUS information levels)
assumptions: Concept-system inventory, not a fabricated or installed sign count.

annual_program_family_count.formula: count(distinct OP-01...OP-04 rows in section '年度活动体系')
assumptions: Proposed recurring-program inventory; no event date, funding, venue, or organizer is confirmed.

floor_area_ratio.reason: The public site package marks floor_area_ratio as missing; concept footprints do not supply floor area.
floor_area_ratio.needed_from: approved regulatory planning conditions or official design brief attachments

building_height_m.reason: The public site package marks building_height_m as missing; no height is inferred from OSM or concept footprints.
building_height_m.needed_from: approved height controls, aviation/landscape/heritage constraints if applicable

building_density.reason: The public site package marks the statutory building-density control as missing; concept-module density is not substituted.

statutory_green_ratio.reason: The public site package marks the statutory green ratio as missing; green_ratio above is only a recomputed design-proposal ratio.
statutory_green_ratio.needed_from: approved regulatory planning conditions or local green-space standards

setback_m.reason: The public site package marks setbacks as missing; no road-redline or fire-control inference is made.
setback_m.needed_from: road redline, building control line, fire and municipal constraints

affected_household_count.reason: OSM interface leads cannot establish households, occupancy, tenure, vulnerability, or causation.
affected_household_count.needed_from: field survey, consented/cleared household data, official address/building data, and a professionally confirmed impact method

mitigation_budget_cny.reason: No verified action quantities, unit costs, compensation rules, funding commitment, or responsible-party agreement is available.
mitigation_budget_cny.needed_from: verified mitigation ledger, reviewed unit rates, affected-party process, funding agreement, and human approval

ecosystem_partner_count.formula: count(organizations with cleared identity, signed role, effective term, and disclosure permission)
ecosystem_partner_count.reason: No cleared project partner roster or signed participation record is available.
ecosystem_partner_count.needed_from: cleared organization registry, signed role/term records, and publication permission

compute_capacity.formula: sum(available capacity under one disclosed unit, time window, service level, and access rule)
compute_capacity.reason: No provider-neutral capacity inventory, service window, allocation rule, or energy/cost record is available.
compute_capacity.needed_from: cleared compute inventory, common unit, service-level window, access policy, cost and energy records

service_use_ratio.reason: No cleared event log or verified serviceable-population denominator exists.
service_use_ratio.needed_from: privacy-reviewed aggregate event log, service-open record, population denominator, exclusions, and audit signature

approved_scenario_count.formula: count(concept scenarios with site, operator, safety, privacy, accessibility, and human-review approvals all effective)
approved_scenario_count.reason: The package contains concept cards only and no approval record.
approved_scenario_count.needed_from: site and operator confirmations plus safety, privacy, accessibility, and human-review approvals

annual_participant_count.reason: No event schedule, registration system, privacy notice, or attendance log exists.
annual_participant_count.needed_from: approved annual schedule, opt-in registration rules, privacy notice, deduplication method, and attendance log

developer_to_pilot_conversion_ratio.reason: No eligible cohort, approved pilot ledger, or common observation window exists.
developer_to_pilot_conversion_ratio.needed_from: opt-in cohort registry, eligibility rule, approved pilot ledger, observation window, and independent audit
